source: D5.2 Final, Annex 4 tenet assessment form

questions.text_en: To what extent does this measure contribute to achieving environmental targets and safeguarding ecosystem features and functioning?
Is the necessary technology available and proven to support the implementation and long-term maintenance of this measure?
Does this measure offer good value for money compared to other alternatives, considering both costs and benefits?
Will this measure improve economic viability, both in the short-term and long-term, considering revenue relative to costs?
To what extent do you believe stakeholders will support this measure, or might there be resistance?
To what extent is this measure ethically sound and morally acceptable?
To what extent does this measure consider and respect local customs and practices?
To what extent does this measure comply with existing regional, national, and international laws and regulations?
To what extent are the administrative processes and transaction costs manageable for implementing this measure?
To what extent can this measure be effectively communicated to the public, and does it align with the current political landscape?
To what extent does this measure align with the prevailing political climate and have the support of political leaders?
